changelog: Play more than one account at once: with a game open, pick another account at the top right and press Play, or use Play next to it in the account menu.
Each extra account plays from its own game folder, set up with your settings, HUD layout and servers.
The RAM slider now fits your PC: it only goes as high as your PC can spare, suggests the best amount, and warns when there isn't enough free memory.
New players start with the recommended amount of RAM for their PC.
F2 now copies the screenshot to your clipboard, ready to paste into Discord. Turn it off with Screenshot Copy.
Opening AitoClient while it's already open brings the open window to the front.
The launcher comes back when you close the game, even with Close on Launch on.
Player heads in the launcher load reliably instead of showing a blank face.
The game log no longer grows forever; it could reach hundreds of MB.

changes: Play more than one account at once: with a game open, pick another account at the top right and press Play, or use Play next to it in the account menu.
Each extra account plays from its own game folder, set up with your settings, HUD layout and servers.
The RAM slider now fits your PC: it only goes as high as your PC can spare, suggests the best amount, and warns when there isn't enough free memory.
New players start with the recommended amount of RAM for their PC.
F2 now copies the screenshot to your clipboard, ready to paste into Discord. Turn it off with Screenshot Copy.
Opening AitoClient while it's already open brings the open window to the front.
The launcher comes back when you close the game, even with Close on Launch on.
Player heads in the launcher load reliably instead of showing a blank face.
The game log no longer grows forever; it could reach hundreds of MB.
Sign in to new Microsoft accounts right from the in-game account switcher.
Remove accounts with the X, in the game and in the launcher.
The launcher shows each account's status (Ready, Checking, Sign in again, Can't reach Microsoft) and renews sign-ins automatically.
Sign-ins are now stored encrypted by Windows, and the game no longer reads a plain-text accounts file.
New AitoClient logo in the launcher, the game and the installer.
New night background for the main menu and the launcher, sharp at any screen size.
Dark Mojang loading screen, now in HD.
Sharper text, and menus sized properly on large and fullscreen windows.
Redesigned "You're signed in" page.
New default HUD layout for new players.
The Armor Set HUD shows full set names, like Deadcurion Set and Wandering Champion Set.
Fixed adding an account in game removing your other accounts and keeping the old skin.
Fixed the main menu losing its dark look after leaving a world.
Fixed fly boost staying on with Toggle Sprint turned off.
Fixed the Pots counter disappearing on smaller windows.
Fixed the game failing to start for some players with their own Minecraft install; there's no need to rename .minecraft anymore.
HUD elements now keep their position when you change resolution or window size.
Redesigned account switcher with smooth rounded corners.
Fixed HUD layouts resetting to default after relaunching the game.
HUD rescue is now a manual option instead of running automatically at startup.
Fixed deleted profiles coming back after a restart.
Armor and overlay mods now reset correctly when you switch servers.
HUD editor scale option.
Global color option shared across mods.
Profile fixes.
Fixed entities turning invisible with Fullbright enabled.
New Fullbright mode that brightens the world without washing out colors.
Chroma colors are now in sync across all HUD mods.
HUD elements can be stacked.
Account switcher.
A broken or corrupted profile no longer crashes the game on load.
Safeguard that recovers HUD elements stuck off-screen.
Fullbright fixes.
Better default HUD layout.
Fixed menus jumping back to the top when scrolling.
Freelook start pitch is now configurable (defaults to 30 degrees above the horizon).
Refreshed the default PvP profile.
HUD, visibility and cooldown fixes.
Updated AitoClient icon and branding.
